messages:
Lina: OK team, time-sensitive and extremely serious: nominations open for 'Kitchen Legend' — who gets the ceremonial enamel mug and the honorary napkin cape? :trophy:
harry: I nominate Jules for stealing everyone's biscotti but leaving polite Post-its. It’s a vibe. :eyes:
Jules: guilty as charged. I leave notes. It’s an art. Also I will accept the mug only if it comes with a tiny flag that says 'I make tea'
sana: @Jules that counts as both a confession and a public service announcement. +1 from me. :coffee:
Lina: poll by emoji please — :trophy: for Jules, :coffee: for harry, :ghost: for someone else / write-in. I'll tally at 5pm.
harry: putting up my campaign poster in #kitchen-photos. may contain questionable Photoshop skills. :sweat_smile:
Jules: campaign promises: 1) Share the good jams, 2) never microwave someone else's lunch w/o permission, 3) ritual biscotti placement on Friday mornings.
ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen-door auto-lock schedule changed to 19:00 on weekdays. (posted by ops-bot)
Lina: also, new lore proposal: the Person Who Refills the Coffee Grinder gets the title 'Grindkeeper' and a paper crown. Thoughts? :crown:
sana: If we combine titles, Jules becomes "Kitchen Legend & Grindkeeper" which is terrifyingly prestigious. :laughing:
harry: vote update — :trophy: (Jules) x3, :coffee: (harry) x1, :ghost: x0. Looks like a coronation incoming. :confetti_ball:
Jules: I hereby accept under the condition that the napkin cape is embroidered with the company mascot (or a very small potato). Also demand ceremonial oath: "I pledge to keep the kettle warm and the biscotti sacred."
Lina: oath approved. We'll do a quick 30-second coronation at 4:50 today by the microwave. Costumes optional, morale mandatory. :sparkles:
sana: can someone record? I want this on the inevitable lore timeline doc. Also suggest we institute a small trophy that circulates monthly so we have reasons to celebrate.
harry: recording with my phone — will upload to #kitchen-photos and the sacred drive folder.
ops-bot: Event created: Kitchen Legend Coronation — today 16:50, Kitchen. Invite sent to participants.
Jules: thanks y'all. I will prepare biscuits and a haiku. "mug in hand, crumbs fall, legends rise between coffee breaks." You're welcome. :v:
Lina: official sticker idea: "Certified Biscotti Steward" — @design, we may need a sticker run. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
sana: can we make one that glows in the dark? Asking for a friend who is nocturnal.
harry: also can we have a sash? imagine the photo ops.
Lina: sash and cape procured. coronation dress code: business-casual + one ridiculous accessory. See you at 4:50.
